quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You and a friend are arguing about money you lent them.
quests.correctAnswer: Bring up the topic calmly and directly
quests.hint: Say: 'I wanted to check in about the money I lent you. Is there a time that works for paying it back?'
quests.explanation: Bringing up money directly but calmly prevents both financial loss and friendship damage.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You and a friend are arguing about money you lent them.
quests.correctAnswer: Agree on a repayment schedule
quests.hint: Suggest: 'How about paying back a small amount each month? Whatever works for you.'
quests.explanation: Flexible repayment plans keep friendships intact while ensuring you get your money back.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You and a friend are arguing about money you lent them.
quests.correctAnswer: Keep a written record for future lending
quests.hint: After this experience consider using a simple written note for any future loans.
quests.explanation: Learning from financial conflicts helps you manage similar situations better in the future.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A fellow passenger reclines their seat into your space on a long flight.
quests.correctAnswer: Politely ask if they could raise it a little
quests.hint: Say quietly: 'Excuse me would you mind raising your seat slightly? I am finding it a bit tight.'
quests.explanation: A polite request on a flight is usually enough to resolve personal space conflicts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A fellow passenger reclines their seat into your space on a long flight.
quests.correctAnswer: Adjust your own position to manage the space
quests.hint: Sometimes tilting your own screen or moving your tray differently is easier than a conversation.
quests.explanation: Finding practical workarounds in public travel reduces unnecessary interpersonal conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A fellow passenger reclines their seat into your space on a long flight.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a flight attendant if you can change seats
quests.hint: If the space is genuinely uncomfortable asking to move is a perfectly reasonable solution.
quests.explanation: Knowing when to involve a neutral third party like cabin crew resolves conflicts efficiently.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You find out a colleague earns more than you for doing the same job.
quests.correctAnswer: Request a private salary review meeting
quests.hint: Contact your manager: 'I would like to schedule a meeting to discuss my compensation and role contribution.'
quests.explanation: Requesting a formal salary review is the professional and effective approach to pay inequality.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You find out a colleague earns more than you for doing the same job.
quests.correctAnswer: Prepare evidence of your performance before the meeting
quests.hint: Gather records of your achievements projects and positive feedback to support your case.
quests.explanation: Evidence-based salary discussions are far more likely to succeed than emotional ones.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You find out a colleague earns more than you for doing the same job.
quests.correctAnswer: Research market rates for your role
quests.hint: Use salary comparison websites to understand what similar roles pay. This gives you a factual basis.
quests.explanation: Market data strengthens your position in salary negotiations and removes guesswork.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A team member consistently misses deadlines and it is affecting the whole team.
quests.correctAnswer: Have a one-to-one conversation to understand why
quests.hint: Ask: 'I have noticed the deadlines have been difficult lately. Is there anything making the work harder?'
quests.explanation: Understanding the cause of missed deadlines is more productive than simply complaining about them.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A team member consistently misses deadlines and it is affecting the whole team.
quests.correctAnswer: Work together to set more realistic timelines
quests.hint: Suggest: 'Let us look at the upcoming deadlines together and see if any need adjusting.'
quests.explanation: Collaborating on timelines increases ownership and reduces the chance of future missed deadlines.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A team member consistently misses deadlines and it is affecting the whole team.
quests.correctAnswer: Escalate to a manager with documentation
quests.hint: If the issue continues after direct conversation inform your manager with specific examples and dates.
quests.explanation: Escalating with documentation protects the team and ensures the problem is addressed formally.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You strongly disagree with a decision made by your school or university.
quests.correctAnswer: Use the official complaint or feedback channel
quests.hint: Submit a formal complaint through the institution's process. Explain your objection clearly and respectfully.
quests.explanation: Using official channels shows you are serious and gives your complaint the best chance of being heard.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You strongly disagree with a decision made by your school or university.
quests.correctAnswer: Gather support from others who feel the same
quests.hint: Talk to classmates. A group complaint carries more weight than an individual one.
quests.explanation: Collective action is one of the most effective ways to challenge institutional decisions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You strongly disagree with a decision made by your school or university.
quests.correctAnswer: Request a meeting with the relevant department head
quests.hint: Ask for a meeting: 'I would like to discuss this decision and understand the reasoning behind it.'
quests.explanation: Direct dialogue with decision-makers provides clarity and may lead to a review of the decision.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: During a job interview the interviewer asks a question that feels inappropriate.
quests.correctAnswer: Stay calm and decide whether to answer or redirect
quests.hint: You can say: 'I would prefer to focus on my professional qualifications. My skills in X are particularly relevant here.'
quests.explanation: Knowing how to redirect inappropriate questions professionally protects you without causing confrontation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: During a job interview the interviewer asks a question that feels inappropriate.
quests.correctAnswer: Answer briefly and steer back to your strengths
quests.hint: Give a brief non-revealing answer and pivot: '...but more relevant to this role is my experience with...'
quests.explanation: The pivot technique lets you handle uncomfortable questions while keeping the interview on track.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: During a job interview the interviewer asks a question that feels inappropriate.
quests.correctAnswer: Note the question and decide if you want to raise it after
quests.hint: If it genuinely felt discriminatory you may wish to report it to HR or the recruiter afterwards.
quests.explanation: Knowing your legal rights and the reporting process is important professional knowledge.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your partner's family frequently offers unsolicited parenting advice.
quests.correctAnswer: Acknowledge their intentions while setting limits
quests.hint: Say: 'We really appreciate your experience. We have made our decision on this but we love having your support.'
quests.explanation: Thanking someone for their good intentions while holding your position is a powerful boundary-setting technique.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your partner's family frequently offers unsolicited parenting advice.
quests.correctAnswer: Discuss the issue with your partner first
quests.hint: Make sure you and your partner agree on how to handle the advice before responding together.
quests.explanation: Presenting a unified front with your partner strengthens your position in family conflicts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your partner's family frequently offers unsolicited parenting advice.
quests.correctAnswer: Redirect advice toward areas where you welcome it
quests.hint: Say: 'We would love your advice on [specific topic] - you have so much experience there.'
quests.explanation: Channelling advice into specific areas keeps the relationship warm while limiting unwanted input.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You need to tell a client that their project will be delayed.
quests.correctAnswer: Inform them early with a clear explanation
quests.hint: Contact them as soon as you know: 'I want to flag that we are encountering a delay and here is why and what we are doing.'
quests.explanation: Early transparent communication of bad news preserves client trust far better than last-minute surprises.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You need to tell a client that their project will be delayed.
quests.correctAnswer: Come to the conversation with a solution
quests.hint: Before calling prepare a revised timeline and a plan to minimise impact. Clients want solutions not just problems.
quests.explanation: Presenting a solution alongside bad news demonstrates professionalism and client focus.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You need to tell a client that their project will be delayed.
quests.correctAnswer: Follow up in writing after the call
quests.hint: Send an email confirming the delay the new timeline and next steps. A written record protects both sides.
quests.explanation: Written follow-up after difficult client conversations creates clarity and accountability.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a community meeting a few loud voices are dominating and others cannot speak.
quests.correctAnswer: Suggest a structured speaking turn
quests.hint: Say: 'Could we go around the room so everyone gets a turn? I think we are missing some important perspectives.'
quests.explanation: Proposing fair process is an effective facilitation technique.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a community meeting a few loud voices are dominating and others cannot speak.
quests.correctAnswer: Invite quieter participants directly
quests.hint: Turn to someone who has not spoken: 'We have not heard from everyone - what do you think?'
quests.explanation: Actively inviting quieter voices creates more balanced group discussions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a community meeting a few loud voices are dominating and others cannot speak.
quests.correctAnswer: Speak to the meeting facilitator privately
quests.hint: If you are not in charge tell the chair quietly: 'Some people have not had a chance to contribute yet.'
quests.explanation: Alerting a facilitator is often more effective than trying to change group dynamics on your own.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You suspect a friend is being dishonest with you about something important.
quests.correctAnswer: Create a safe space for honesty
quests.hint: Say: 'I want you to know that whatever is going on I am not here to judge. I just want to understand.'
quests.explanation: Removing the fear of judgment makes it easier for someone to be honest with you.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You suspect a friend is being dishonest with you about something important.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask open non-accusatory questions
quests.hint: Instead of 'Are you lying to me?' try: 'I have been sensing something is different. Is everything okay?'
quests.explanation: Open questions invite honesty. Accusatory questions cause defensiveness and shutdown.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You suspect a friend is being dishonest with you about something important.
quests.correctAnswer: Share your observation without making it an accusation
quests.hint: Say: 'I have noticed a few things that seem inconsistent and it has been worrying me. Can we talk?'
quests.explanation: Describing your observations instead of your conclusions creates space for the other person to open up.
